notes: The update screen is a real screen now — when an update is found you see the patch notes first, then a progress bar with the percent, megabytes downloaded and a live time-remaining estimate while it downloads, and two clear buttons: Install now or Install later

Install now shows an Installing… state and reopens the app on the new version; Install later keeps it staged so it installs next time you close the app — no more silent toasts deciding everything for you
Patch notes on the update screen come straight from the same changelog the app shows in What's new, so they are never empty or generic
